verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Lovable issues workspace API keys (Business/Enterprise plans), but nothing shows those keys can be limited by scope, permission set, or project to give an agent least-privilege access. The 'permissions and access' configuration applies to turning a user's published app into an MCP server, and enterprise 'granular access controls' cover workspace governance; neither is scoped credential issuance for Lovable's own API, so both are adjacent features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
